definitions.explanation: A strategic board game originating in ancient China, played by placing black and white stones to capture territory.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{碁|ご}が{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: My grandfather is good at Go.

notes:
{碁|ご} is the board game Go (also called {囲碁|いご}) - a strategic game played with black and white stones.

GO VOCABULARY:
- {碁盤|ごばん}: Go board
- {碁石|ごいし}: Go stones
- {碁|ご}を{打|う}つ: to play Go (not する or やる)
- {囲碁|いご}: Go (full name)

LEVELS:
- プロ{棋士|きし}: professional Go player
- アマチュア: amateur player
- {段|だん}: dan (rank for stronger players)
- {級|きゅう}: kyu (rank for beginners)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Go originated in China over 2,500 years ago. It's one of the four traditional arts ({琴棋書画|きんきしょが}) - music, Go, calligraphy, and painting.

RELATED:
- {将棋|しょうぎ}: shogi (Japanese chess)
